footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to UMH Properties: after $20.3M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 8.8% to $262M in 2025. Gross margin was 91.4%, versus 90.9% a year earlier, and operating income rose 22.2% to $26.3M, a 10.1% margin.
Net income rose 2.4× to $6.0M, or $0.07 per share. Operating cash flow was $82.0M and free cash flow −$32.4M, versus −$10.5M; UMH Properties returned $76.0M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: UMH Properties, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
